recording: Recording. Click stop when finished; recording stops after 2 minutes.

errorDialog.title: Voice input could not finish
errorDialog.draftKept: Transcribed text has been kept in your draft. Close this message, then click the microphone to start again.

errors.upstream_auth: Doubao ASR authentication failed (401). Ask an administrator to check that the Speech Console API key is correct and still valid, and check which key source the server uses. Saving a key or enabling voice input does not validate the key.
errors.upstream_forbidden: Doubao ASR denied access (403). Ask an administrator to check this API key's streaming speech recognition permissions, service activation, and resource configuration.
errors.upstream_rate_limited: Doubao ASR request or concurrency limits have been reached. Try again later; if this continues, ask an administrator to check the speech service quota.
errors.upstream_unavailable: Doubao ASR is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.upstream_timeout: Doubao ASR did not respond in time. Check the connection and try again.
errors.upstream_closed: Doubao ASR closed the connection before transcription finished. Start a new recording to try again.
errors.upstream_rejected: Doubao ASR rejected this recognition request. Ask an administrator to check the speech service configuration before trying again.
errors.insecure: Microphone access requires HTTPS or localhost.
errors.unsupported: This browser does not support microphone recording. Try a current version of Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
errors.permission: Microphone permission was denied. Allow microphone access and try again. If no prompt appears, check the app or browser permission settings.
errors.microphone: Could not use the microphone. Check the input device and try again.
errors.connection: The voice connection was interrupted. Your transcribed text is still in the draft.
errors.timeout: Voice input timed out. Your draft has been kept; try again.
errors.backpressure: The connection or device cannot keep up with recording. Recording stopped and your draft has been kept.
errors.server: The speech service is unavailable. Ask an administrator to check the Doubao ASR configuration.
errors.no_speech: No text was recognized. Check the selected microphone and try speaking closer to it. If soft speech is repeatedly missed, ask an administrator to try Raw capture in voice settings.
errors.audio_too_quiet: The microphone signal is too quiet to recognize. Move closer or increase the device input volume. If this does not help, ask an administrator to try Raw capture in voice settings.

settings.title: Voice input
settings.description: Use Doubao streaming speech recognition to dictate into your chat draft.
settings.enableHelp: Off by default. Save a Doubao ASR API key first, then turn on this switch. Saving a key does not enable voice input.
settings.keyHelp: Use an API key from the Volcengine Speech Console with access to streaming speech recognition. An Ark text-model key cannot be used here.
settings.enterKey: Enter your Doubao ASR API key
settings.replaceKey: A key is configured. Enter a new key to replace it.

source.stored: An API key is stored on the server. Its value is never returned to the browser.
source.environment: Using the server environment key. Environment configuration takes priority over a saved key.

settings.privacy: After you click the microphone, audio is sent through this server to Volcengine for recognition. Text stays in your draft until you send it. Requires HTTPS or localhost; each recording lasts up to 2 minutes.
settings.saved: Voice settings saved. The key will be validated when voice input starts.
settings.loadError: Could not load voice settings. Refresh the page to try again.
settings.saveError: Could not save voice settings. Check your administrator access and try again.
settings.captureModeHelp: Voice processing works best on most devices. If soft speech is often missed, try raw capture, which disables browser echo cancellation, noise suppression and automatic gain control. Some phones are quieter in raw mode; switch back if recognition gets worse. Applies to the next recording after saving.
settings.hotwordsHelp: Add names, project names or terms that are often misrecognized, one per line or separated by commas. Up to 100 entries, with at most 64 characters each.
settings.hotwordTooLong: Each entry must contain at most 64 characters.
